hooks.command: "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/loom-python" --ready delivery --hook --host claude; loom_hook_exit_code=$?; if [ "$loom_hook_exit_code" -ne 0 ]; then echo 'loom: delivery unconfirmed; rerun the original hook command in an agent station, replacing --ready with --repair and --hook with --json, removing --host and its value, and preserving its executable path, other arguments, working directory and stdin before claiming completion.' >&2; fi; exit 0

if python3 -c 'import json,sys; assert sys.version_info >= (3,7)' >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/language-anchor.py"; fi; "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/loom-python" --ready --script ../hooks/language-anchor.py; loom_hook_exit_code=$?; if [ "$loom_hook_exit_code" -eq 86 ]; then exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/language-anchor.py"; fi; exit "$loom_hook_exit_code"

if [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/loom_checker.py" ]; then "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/loom-python" --ready push --hook; loom_hook_exit_code=$?; if [ "$loom_hook_exit_code" -eq 86 ]; then echo 'loom: publication hook failed (checker runtime unavailable; rerun the original hook command in an agent station, replacing --ready with --repair and preserving its executable path, arguments, working directory and stdin); allowing.' >&2; exit 0; fi; exit "$loom_hook_exit_code"; else cat >/dev/null; echo "loom: publication hook failed (installed checker is unavailable at ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/loom_checker.py; restart Claude Code to load the installed plugin version); allowing." >&2; exit 0; fi

if python3 -c 'import json,sys; assert sys.version_info >= (3,7)' >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/language-anchor.py"; fi; "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/loom-python" --ready --script ../hooks/language-anchor.py; loom_hook_exit_code=$?; if [ "$loom_hook_exit_code" -eq 86 ]; then exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/language-anchor.py"; fi; exit "$loom_hook_exit_code"
